messages:
sasha: Heads-up — nightly eval (run id rne-1865) shows a ~9.4% drop on QAG-long for rdlw-llama3-70b when serving with the new INT8 precision profile applied. Sample failures attached below. :eyes:

jamie: ack, can you paste one of the failing prompts + the generations? also which precision profile name did the jobs pick up?

sasha: picking one short sample here:

sasha: Prompt: "Summarize the legal obligations for a contractor under UK construction law regarding latent defects discovered after completion. Provide checklist items and citations."

sasha: Baseline (FP16) excerpt: "Key obligations: duty to disclose, reasonable inspection clauses, timeframe for latent defects claims (Limitation Act 1980 s.2), and remedies including rectification and damages. Checklist: inspect, notify, record evidence, engage counsel."

sasha: INT8 generation (nightly): "No obligations. The contractor is free after completion. See Clause 3." — short, incorrect, missing citations, hallucinated clause refs.

ravi: that's a big semantic collapse for legal QA. Did the nightlies pick up the new quant-profile: `int8-econ-v2` we merged yesterday?

sasha: yes, the rollout targets hosted:dense/rdlw-llama3-70b and dedicated pools. Job config shows `quant_profile: int8-econ-v2` in the eval jobs.

jamie: quick check: maybe scale/zero-point mismatch on conv weights after packing. I'm running the reproducer locally with the same profile. Pasting inference logs:

jamie: ```
jamie: [2026-11-22 03:14:12] load model rdlw-llama3-70b
jamie: [2026-11-22 03:14:13] applying quant_profile int8-econ-v2
jamie: [2026-11-22 03:14:13] quant table loaded: id=qp-334, version=20261121
jamie: [2026-11-22 03:14:13] warn: per-channel-scales unusual variance > 6.2x for layer 32
jamie: [2026-11-22 03:14:13] infer: output truncated at 128 tokens (expected 512)
jamie: ```

maria: fwiw I just diffed qp-334 against qp-312 (previous good): scale ratios show a block-level transpose flag flipped in the tooling that merges per-tensor->per-channel tables. Suspect PR #8423 that touched quant table exporter.

ravi: thanks — copying that to the PR. @infra-bot can you show which deployment picked up qp-334 and the exact commit hash?

infra-bot: Deploy bot: `deployment/dedicated-1` rolled out quant profile qp-334 at 2026-11-22T03:03:10Z. Commit: 8f4c2e1 (merge PR 8423). Canary: 100% after 00:45:12.

maria: quick repro command if others want to run the isolated check:

maria: ```bash
maria: ./tools/repro_infer.sh --model rdlw-llama3-70b --quant-profile qp-334 --prompt-file samples/qag-long/failure1.txt --max-tokens 512 --device cuda:0
maria: ```

jamie: ran repro, reproduced the missing citations and early cut. Looking at raw logits, there's a sudden drop in top-k before token 40 which matches an aggressive clip in the quantized linear op. Suspect scale underflow on a subset of kernels.

sasha: plan? roll back profile or revert exporter PR? Need to decide quickly — this affects nightly/regression alerts and some customer flows.

ravi: mitigation: pin the eval and hosted routing to qp-312 and disable auto-rollout for int8-econ-v2 until we patch. I'll open a rollback change with ops.

maria: I'll prepare a minimal failing unit test for the exporter that demonstrates the transpose flag mismatch and add CI to prevent future exports.

jamie: I'll craft a small patch that corrects scale reshaping in the runtime (safe fix) and run perf smoke. If it passes, we can re-roll qp-334 with corrected exporter and runtime patch.

infra-bot: Ops change request created: CHG-2026-1147 — rollback quant-profile qp-334 to qp-312 on `hosted` + `dedicated-1` (ETA 20m).

sasha: thanks. @ravi please also add alert suppression for QAG-long until after rollback so we don't spam the team. :+1:

ravi: will do. suppressing flakiness alerts for QAG-long windows [2026-11-22T03:00,2026-11-22T04:00].

maria: uploaded a short diff to PR 8423 branch with tests in `tests/quant` — link: https://git.internal/r/8423. Use `make test-quant` to run locally.

jamie: after rollback I'll kick a smoke eval with both qp-312 and a patched qp-334 to compare. If patched passes, we'll schedule a staged rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with monitoring on QAG-long and legal-qa promptsets.

sasha: great. keep updates here. I'll mark this thread as incident reference for the eval alert. :spiral_notepad:
